versions.changelog:
Initial release of poyo-seedream-5-0-lite skill.

- Supports Seedream 5.0 Lite image generation and editing via PoYo API.
- Enables 2K/3K high-resolution output and flexible aspect-ratio control.
- Allows multi-reference image editing (up to 10 images).
- Distinguishes between generation and edit workflows with clear model selection.
- Outputs task IDs for easy job tracking and polling.
